feed.title: LLM Frontier: IFBench advances
feed.subtitle: Each entry is a date on which a model became the cheapest way to reach some level of IFBench, through a release or a price change.

entry.title: 2026-06-01: MiniMax-M3 (new model, IFBench 82.9%)
entry.summary: MiniMax-M3: pushed the IFBench ceiling from 81.3% to 82.9%, at $0.14 per task, taking it from Grok 4.3, which left the frontier. New cost record for IFBench ≥ 80%. Open weights.

entry.title: 2026-04-30: Grok 4.3 (high) (new model, IFBench 81.3%)
entry.summary: Grok 4.3 (high): pushed the IFBench ceiling from 79.9% to 81.3%, at $0.15 per task. New cost record for IFBench ≥ 80%. Proprietary.

entry.title: 2026-04-22: MiMo-V2.5-Pro (new model, IFBench 79.9%)
entry.summary: MiMo-V2.5-Pro: pushed the IFBench ceiling from 78.8% to 79.9%, at $0.034 per task, taking it from Qwen3.5 397B A17B, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, and GPT-5 mini, all of which left the frontier. Open weights.

entry.title: 2026-04-22: MiMo-V2.5 (new model, IFBench 67.1%)
entry.summary: MiMo-V2.5: now the cheapest way to reach IFBench 0.0% to 67.1% at $0.010 per task, taking it from NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 30B A3B, gpt-oss-120b, and Llama 4 Scout; gpt-oss-120b and Llama 4 Scout left the frontier. New cost record for IFBench ≥ 60%. Open weights.
